name: @alberonda/mcp-trust-gateway-relay-agent
description: Executes MCP server subprocesses on behalf of a remote mcp-trust-gateway deployment, for servers only reachable from this machine's network -- holds no database credentials and no master encryption key, only a real GATEWAY_API_KEY and, per active call, whatever decrypted env the gateway sends it. See ../DESIGN.md's 'Role-based access control' postscripts for why this exists.
